payout_quote: Northwest Clinical Trials official Refer A Friend page (nwct.com): 'You will receive $100 for every volunteer you refer who qualifies and enrolls in a study. There is no limit on how many friends you can refer.'
steps: Open Northwest Clinical Trials' official Refer A Friend page and check their currently-enrolling studies (e.g. Alzheimer's, adult and pediatric migraine, OCD, motion sickness, depression, type 2 diabetes).
Refer someone you know who may qualify for one of their trials in Boise, Idaho.
Your referral must qualify for and enroll in a study (screening determines eligibility; not everyone qualifies).
Receive $100 for every volunteer you refer who qualifies and enrolls; there is no limit on how many friends you can refer.
catches: You only earn if your referred person actually qualifies for and enrolls in a study - you cannot refer yourself into pay without a qualifying participant.
Referred volunteers must pass medical screening; not everyone qualifies.
Referrals are tied to NWCT's specific trials in Boise, Idaho; your network must be local and eligible.
Trial availability changes; enrollment must be current for a referral to count.
biggest_catch: You earn nothing unless people you refer actually qualify for and enroll in a NWCT trial - this is a referral funnel, not payment for participating, and it's limited to NWCT's Boise trials.
eligibility: You must know people who may qualify for one of NWCT's currently-enrolling studies in Boise, Idaho; the referred volunteer must qualify and enroll.
timing: Paid per qualifying enrolled referral; no limit on referrals.
